recorderPauseMinutes: {count, plural, one {Pause for # minute} other {Pause for # minutes}}
recorderFooterRunning: Running · Most changes apply immediately. Idle threshold and output folder changes apply to the next session.
recorderFooterStopped: Off · Most changes apply immediately. Idle threshold and output folder changes apply to the next session.
modelsRedactSecretsHelp: API keys, access tokens, passwords and private keys.
modelsRedactPersonalHelp: Email addresses, phone numbers, ID numbers and bank card numbers.
modelsEffortHelp: Higher levels think longer and cost more per summary.
modelsAutoHelp: While recording, sends new activity to the selected model at most once every {minutes} minutes for a summary.
modelsRedactHelp: Replaces the selected kinds of text with placeholders before sending, then puts the originals back into the summary.
generalAgentDescription: With this skill, agents such as Claude Code and Codex can look up the activity recorded on this Mac, including summaries, time blocks, screen text and screenshots. Agents can read the record but cannot change it.
generalAgentPromptHelp: Paste it into the chat with your agent. The agent installs the skill and runs a test query.
generalAgentPromptText:
Install the Konseki skill. Konseki records activity on my Mac, and the skill lets you look up what I did.
1. Run {install}
2. Read SKILL.md in the skill and use the read-only Konseki command as it describes.
3. Run {status} and tell me the result.
generalAgentInstallHelp: Run it in a terminal to install the skill for the agents on this Mac.
generalAgentRedact: Text that agents read is redacted with the settings on the Models page. Screenshots are not redacted.
generalAgentLinkError: Could not create the command link: {error}
generalAgentLegacyHelp: {count, plural, one {{dir} has # file from the old skill export.} other {{dir} has # files from the old skill export.}} The files no longer update and sit where the new skill installs.
generalAgentLegacyError: Could not delete the old files: {error}
recorderStorageHelp: In MB, from 100 to 200,000. Older screenshots are automatically shrunk and recompressed, so the same space holds more history.
recorderPermissionRestart: Restart Konseki after granting screen recording access.
recorderOCRDescription: Recognize screenshot text on this device.
recorderInputDescription: Count keys and clicks without recording their contents.
recorderOCREveryHelp: Recognize every N snapshots, from 1 to 20.
recorderSensitiveHelp: Nothing is captured while one of these apps is in front. One bundle ID per line.
recorderSessionDetails: {minutes} min · {count, plural, one {# snapshot} other {# snapshots}}
recorderEnableDescription: Takes periodic screenshots, reads screen text and counts keys and clicks to build your daily receipt. Screenshots stay on this device.
recorderRetentionDescription: How long to keep screenshots and screen text. Summaries do not expire.
recorderDebounceHelp: Shortest gap between two captures. Triggers inside it merge into one capture.
recorderHeartbeatHelp: Capture at this interval without other triggers. An unchanged screen saves no new image.
recorderIdleHelp: End the current session after this long without clicks, keys or scrolling.
recorderTypingHelp: Capture once typing has stopped for this long.
recorderPollHelp: Without input, check the screen for changes at this interval. 0 turns it off.
recorderQualityHelp: JPEG quality. Lower values give smaller files.
recorderStorageEvict: Over the limit, the oldest screenshots and records are deleted down to 90%.
recorderClearDescription: Delete snapshots, screenshots, sessions and screen text in the current output folder, plus summaries and exported journals. Settings and keys are kept. Previous output folders are not cleared. This cannot be undone.
recorderDeleteFailed: {count, plural, one {# file could not be deleted} other {# files could not be deleted}}
tabsSetup: Set up a model in Settings →
tabsLanguageHelp: Used for the interface, the receipt and summaries.
receiptEmptyPast: No activity recorded on this day
receiptThanks: Thank you · Data stays on this device
